questions.question: Change 3 kg to grams and 4 600 g to kilograms and grams.
questions.expected_answer: 3 kg is 3 times 1 000, which is 3 000 g. 4 600 g divided by 1 000 is 4 with 600 left over, so it is 4 kg 600 g.

questions.question: How many grams are in a quarter of a kilogram and in 2 and 1/2 kg?
questions.expected_answer: A quarter of 1 000 g is 250 g. 2 and 1/2 kg is 2 000 g plus 500 g, which is 2 500 g.

questions.question: A bag holds 2 and 1/2 kg of flour. Each batch of scones needs 500 g. How many batches can be baked?
questions.expected_answer: Change to the same unit: 2 and 1/2 kg is 2 500 g. 2 500 divided by 500 is 5, so 5 batches can be baked.
